items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 57:1
items.html: (To the question) They are the phase of the Vav and point of the Yesod of AK, namely the totality of ZON, also all the records of the four levels of Gadlut with their garments. (p. 552, Item 15)
